name: lean_sign
text: A person stands with the left shoulder lightly resting against a bus-stop pole, weight mostly on the left leg and right knee relaxed, arms down. Remain stationary beside the pole.

interaction.evidence: Measured build geometry, fixture ranges specified in source SOMA world coordinates.
